verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers card creation, controls, transactions, disputes, and webhooks, but contains no documentation of PIN set/reset endpoints or 3DS enrollment flows, despite this being a standard axis for a card-issuing API platform. Only a vague mention of 'PCI widgets' appears, with no detail tying it to PIN management or 3DS. missing for 10: PIN set/reset API endpoints, 3DS enrollment API documentation, any card-holder credential self-service flow evidence.
